info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contribution Models Retrieval API
info.description: The Contribution Models Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about specific contribution models within the banking system. This endpoint is designed for financial analysts and developers who need to retrieve model configurations associated with a particular identifier. By utilizing this API, users can better understand the parameters and rules governing contributions, facilitating enhanced decision-making and compliance. Typical use cases include generating reports, conducting analyses, and integrating these contributions into larger financial applications.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific contribution model by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific contribution model identified by its unique ID. Use this to get insights into the model's parameters and configurations.
